verdict.rationale: Exa documents an `output_schema` parameter that works with any search type to extract structured JSON from search results (exa-docs-3). The SDK confirms schema enforcement for object types (exa-gh-6), and the Agent API advertises built-in structured results (exa-docs-26). However, the schema is constrained to a maximum nesting depth of 2 and at most 10 total properties, so arbitrary developer-defined schemas are not supported. Missing for 10: support for deeper or larger schemas beyond the depth-2/10-property limits, in-depth docs on schema validation and failure behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration of the output_schema feature.
